probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Skip to content Dario Castelli Architect, Milan Projects About Journal Contact [email protected] LinkedIn Instagram Overview Casa Lario House, Lake Como, 2025 House, Lake Como, 2025 Housing, Milan, 2024 Public building, Varese, 2023 Pavilion, Cervia, 2022 View project 01 Casa Lario 2025 02 Corte Vigentina 2024 03 Biblioteca Olona 2023 04 Padiglione Cervia 2022 Few materials, built to last Dario Castelli grew up in Bergamo and studied architecture in Milan and Zurich. His studio works on houses, housing and small public buildings across northern Italy, always with a short list of materials chosen for how they will look in fifty years.
